_WARNING: NEGATIVE EXPECTANCY. This is an OBSERVATION HARNESS, not a strategy. V5_FINDINGS §3x: all 48 grid cells negative full-sample (best SR -0.44, DD -41.2%); walk-forward SR -0.76 / DD -35.7% against buy-and-hold's +0.79; paired t -3.72; 0 of 8 years better; DSR 0.000; PBO 0.024. Deployed on a DEMO account at the user's explicit request to watch the documented detector operate live. DO NOT point this at a funded account.
purpose: Live observation of the ZigZag bottom detector whose CLASSIFICATION numbers are this project's best (71% precision @ 22% recall, 75% @ 10%, 80% @ 5%, PR-AUC 0.60, 2.1-2.4x lift over a 33.5% random base) but whose TRADED form is disproven. The gap between those two facts is the project's central finding.
account_type: DEMO ONLY — the executor refuses to send on an account not flagged demo
_symbol_note: Resolve the exact FTMO name at first run — FTMO has used both XAUUSD and suffixed variants. The executor prints symbol_info at startup.
_params_note: The WALK-FORWARD-SELECTED cell, not the full-sample best. Re-running §3x's selection (trailing 3y, re-picked each January) gives 2023/2024/2025 = (0.6, 0.6%, 0.5%, 24) and 2026 = (0.6, 0.6%, 0.5%, 48). Threshold 0.6 / TP 0.6% / SL 0.5% is stable across four consecutive years; only max-hold flips. The full-sample best (0.5, 0.6%, 0.5%, 48) scored SR -0.441 and is deliberately NOT used.
_risk_note: 0.25% of equity per trade. Deliberately small: the strategy is expected to lose, so this is sized to make the losses observable rather than material. With SL at 0.5% of price, one trade risks ~$250 on 100K. Backtest activity was 84-176 active days/year, so expect roughly 60-100 trades/year.

expected_behaviour.win_rate: the detector is 71% precise at flagging bottoms, but the TRADE win rate is far lower — TP is +0.6% and SL is -0.5%, so precision at flagging a pivot does not translate into a favourable payoff
expected_behaviour.expected_pnl: NEGATIVE. Per-year walk-forward Sharpe was -0.91/-1.03/-1.81/-1.87/-0.38/+1.19/+0.34/-3.83 for 2019-2026. Two of eight years were positive.
expected_behaviour.what_to_watch: whether the live fill quality, spread and slippage match the $0.448 round-trip the backtest charged. That is the one thing a live run can teach that the backtest cannot.
